customer: I just moved to Texas and I can't find the title for my full-size SUV anywhere in the boxes. I want to sell it to Northwind, and now I'm worried this whole thing is going to stall because of one missing piece of paper. What am I supposed to do?
agent: Sorry for the stress of the move. Good news: Texas uses electronic titles, and for a sale to Northwind you usually don't need the printout, because we transfer the electronic title at your appointment (see States with electronic titles). If you'd still like a printed duplicate for your records, you can request it online from the Texas motor vehicle agency, and it arrives in 5 to 7 business days. You can find more in our article Getting a duplicate title in Texas.
